name: Make Vector
description: Combines three float components (X, Y, Z) into a single Vector value. Used to build positions, directions, scales, or offsets.

inputs.name: X
inputs.description: Horizontal component. Connect a float variable, a literal number, or the output of a math node.

inputs.name: Y
inputs.description: Depth component. Connect a float variable, a literal number, or the output of a math node.

inputs.name: Z
inputs.description: Vertical component. Connect a float variable, a literal number, or the output of a math node.

outputs.name: V
outputs.description: Resulting Vector. Connect to any node that accepts a Vector (e.g. Set Actor Location, Add Force, Break Vector).
